name: vix_vrp_v2
headline: vix_vrp_v2: the original VIX-regime + VRP-crash-filter machine with one added rule -- the ELEVATED regime holds 1x only when the variance risk premium is rich (VIX/100 - RV10 > 0.12), cash otherwise. ALL GATES PASS on dev_1990: Sharpe 0.6783 vs the original's 0.6084 (same -19.8% monthly maxDD, 10.6 chg/yr vs 6.0, cash 62%, plateau 96%, 6/90 Sharpe 0.642); 2000-02 bear +12.9%, GFC -9.5%, 2009 recovery +43.6% of SPY's +67.4%, zero entries to >=2x in either bear. The audit of the original found the 0.61 to be a plateau in hyst/v_calm/rv_win>=7/vrp_min with cliffs at v_panic>=35 and rv_win=5, its Sharpe coming from the 2x CALM and 1x PANIC legs while the ELEVATED cash state (63% of days) protects the bears at the cost of ~+50% of excess return in each of the 1995-99 and 2003-07 bulls; its -28.6% daily GFC drawdown is the VRP-normalised 1x PANIC leg riding Jan-Mar 2009. Tested and rejected one at a time on DEV: 3x CALM (Sharpe 0.55), unconditional 1x ELEVATED (bear -44%), every PANIC dissipation burst (2008 entries 50-100% negative). The original is retired in favour of v2 per the pre-committed rule; the file stays in place unchanged.
biggest_weakness: The Sharpe gain over the original rests on a thin leg: at vrp_elev 0.12 the new ELEVATED 1x is open on only 132 days in 22.5 years (2.3% of days, spells of ~2-3 days, mean excess +19.8 bp/day, leg t-stat about 1.9), so the +0.07 Sharpe is fragile and the gate does NOT fix the cash-by-default cost (it recovered +11.8% of the +51% missed in 1995-99 and +7.3% of +47% in 2003-07); lower thresholds open it more but turn the 2000-02 bear negative below 0.09; the gate also inherits a realised-vol-window sensitivity (the one failed plateau perturbation is rv_win 12 -> Sharpe 0.505; grid D's rv_win 15 row averages 0.53). Structurally v2 is still a VIX-LEVEL machine with the original's untouched -28.6% daily drawdown (1x PANIC through the Jan-Mar-2009 grind with a positive VRP): a prolonged panic that grinds lower with normalised realised vol repeats it, and a bull whose VIX sits at 16-30 with realised vol close to implied is sat out almost entirely.
